## Frequently Asked Questions (AI-curated)
### Do Mac users really need antivirus software like Bitdefender?
Yes. macOS is resilient but not invincible. Modern Macs face real threats including adware, ransomware, and phishing attacks. Bitdefender for Mac provides active protection beyond Apple's built-in defenses. Genuine licenses activate directly with Bitdefender's servers, ensuring full updates and official support throughout the product's life.

### Is Bitdefender or McAfee better in 2026?
In 2026, Bitdefender generally leads McAfee in independent protection scores and lower system impact, while McAfee offers broader multi-device plans. Both provide genuine license activation with full updates. For cost-conscious buyers, perpetual licenses from authorized resellers eliminate recurring subscription fees and typically include free installation support.

### Do I need a VPN if I already have antivirus software?
Antivirus and VPNs protect against different threats. Antivirus blocks malware and viruses, while a VPN encrypts your internet connection and hides your IP. You don't always need both, but bundled licenses can offer strong value. If you use public Wi-Fi or want privacy alongside malware protection, a combined package is worth considering.

### How can non-designers make PowerPoint presentations look more professional?
Non-designers can instantly improve PowerPoint slides by following a few simple rules: use consistent fonts and limit them to two, align elements using a grid, stick to a restrained color palette, add plenty of white space, and avoid cluttering slides with too much text. These layout principles create clean, professional-looking decks without any formal design training.
